title: 连接 Nexa Knowledge
description: 填写腾讯云 API 密钥。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，只用于对腾讯云 API 请求签名。建议使用只授权了 DescribeDataAgentTools、CallDataAgentTool 的子账号密钥。
description_en: Enter a Tencent Cloud API key. Credentials are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy and only used to sign Tencent Cloud API requests. Prefer a sub-account key granted only DescribeDataAgentTools and CallDataAgentTool.
docLabel: 在访问管理控制台获取 API 密钥
